name: Mafia Trends Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2017, Mafia Trends Ltd trades in apparels and ready-made garments.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
a) MTL is registered as a Speciality Retail
 Textile Company. 
b) It is in the business of marketing and selling men’s fashion, which includes casual wear, formal wear, accessories for men, apparel such as jeans, t-shirts, shirts, chinos,
 formal trousers, and formal shirts
c) The company is focused on delivering affordable fashion to Tier II and Tier III cities across India. 
d) It operates through a mix of exclusive brand outlets, franchise stores, and online channels with a growing emphasis on youth-centric fashion.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.54 times its book value
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -7.02% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 4.63% over last 3 years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -23.6%
